headline: Guard note for hugio/copy.go edits
why: This file contains critical functions for file and directory copying, which are directly used by multiple other files. Changes here could lead to widespread issues in file handling across the project.
checklist: Review changes to CopyFile and CopyDir functions
Check impacts on all direct importers listed
Ensure error handling remains intact in CopyFile and CopyDir
Verify that file permissions are correctly managed in CopyFile
